before.aria:
- region "World telemetry":
  - text: NAV
  - button "6 PEAK · 50% ORE"
  - button "Choose another navigation target": ↻
  - text: NARIMATO INFINITE GRID WORLD D0 · 20 FACES
  - status "MAGRATHEA from HITCHHIKER'S GUIDE, planet 1, levels 2": MAGRATHEA LEVELS 2
  - text: YOUR SCORE 0 FACES 0 CLICKS 0 BREAKS 0 ZOOM ×1.0 FOCUS D0
  - navigation "HUD actions":
    - button "REPORT"
  - dialog "MAGRATHEA":
    - paragraph: SURFACE CONTACT // HITCHHIKER'S GUIDE
    - heading "MAGRATHEA" [level=2]
    - paragraph: LEVELS 2 // FIND WHAT SHE NEEDS TO FLY
    - list:
      - listitem: FUEL RODS FIND U URANIUM 0/1
      - listitem: HULL PLATES FIND Au GOLD 0/1
      - listitem: WARP CORE FIND Vg VOIDGLASS · RARE 0/1
    - button "START MINING"
  - complementary "Escape mission objectives":
    - heading "THE WAY HOME" [level=2]
    - text: REFIT IN PROGRESS
    - group "Ship requirements, captain's log and cargo":
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - text: FUEL RODS STILL NEEDED
          - list:
            - 'listitem "URANIUM: 0 of 1"': URANIUM 0/1
        - listitem:
          - text: HULL PLATES STILL NEEDED
          - list:
            - 'listitem "GOLD: 0 of 1"': GOLD 0/1
        - listitem:
          - text: WARP CORE STILL NEEDED
          - list:
            - 'listitem "VOIDGLASS: 0 of 1"': VOIDGLASS · RARE 0/1
      - paragraph: CAPTAIN'S LOG
      - paragraph: We're grounded on MAGRATHEA — HITCHHIKER'S GUIDE. The drive still needs 1 URANIUM and 1 GOLD and 1 VOIDGLASS. The crust can give it to us.
      - text: WHAT WE'RE CARRYING 0
      - list:
        - listitem: The hold is empty. Pick a triangle and see what she's hiding.
    - text: IF WE'RE STILL STUCK 02:00 a relief ship is on the way
    - paragraph: FIND THE PARTS. LIGHT THE DRIVE.
  - complementary "Operators in the world":
    - heading "PILOTS HERE" [level=2]
    - text: 1 ONLINE
    - button "Collapse operators panel" [expanded]
    - list:
      - listitem "PAR033478, 0 points, 0 faces, online": PAR033478 YOU 0 0
  - complementary "All-time arcade top ten":
    - heading "LEGENDS OF THE GRID" [level=2]
    - button "Collapse arcade panel" [expanded]
    - list:
      - 'listitem "Rank 1: PAR033478, score 0, 0 faces held, 0 breaks"': 01 PAR033478 0 0F
  - status: CLICK // MINE · DRAG // ROTATE PLANET · ARROWS // TRAVEL · SHIFT // FASTER · I // REVERSE DRAG · DBL-CLICK // FOCUS
